name: airbrake_deploys_create
title: Create an Airbrake deploy marker
description: Create an Airbrake deploy marker for a project. Each call creates a new deploy (not idempotent). Disabled when AIRBRAKE_READ_ONLY is set. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed.

deploy.description: Deploy fields, e.g. { environment, username, repository, revision, version }. Sent as the top-level POST body.
